blocks.text: like va as: o'xshatish yoki vazifa

O'zbekchada «kabi», «-dek», «sifatida» degan so'zlar ingliz tiliga **like** yoki **as** bo'lib o'tadi, va ularni tanlash ko'p xatoga sabab bo'ladi. Asosiy farq: **like** — **o'xshatish** («... ga o'xshab», «-dek»): narsa yoki odam boshqasiga o'xshaydi, lekin u emas. **as** + ot — **vazifa, rol** («... sifatida», «... bo'lib»): odam yoki narsa rostdan ham shu vazifada. Bundan tashqari, **as** + gap — «... -ganidek» ma'nosini beradi. What is it **like**? savolini siz bilasiz (→ qizil kitob, 46-dars).

**like** bu ma'noda **predlog**: undan keyin ot, olmosh (me, him, yours) yoki **-ing** keladi, to'liq gap emas. Ayniqsa sezgi fe'llari bilan ko'p: **look like**, **sound like**, **feel like**, **smell like**, **taste like** — «... ga o'xshaydi», «... dek tuyuladi». Sifat bilan esa like qo'yilmaydi: You look **tired** («look like tired» emas; → qizil kitob, 85-dars). like dan keyin gap kelsa (look as if ...) — bu keyingi dars mavzusi (→ 118-dars).

items.text: Your bag looks **like** mine — are you sure it's yours?
Walking through the old city at night was **like** being in a fairy tale.
items.translation: Kechasi eski shahar bo'ylab yurish xuddi ertakdagi**dek** edi.

items.text: Bekzod plays the piano **like** a real professional.

blocks.text: **like** yana «**masalan**» ma'nosida ham keladi: ro'yxatdan bir-ikkita misol keltirganda. Bu ma'noda **such as** ham ishlatiladi — u biroz rasmiyroq: big cities **like** / **such as** London and Tashkent.

**as** + ega + fe'l — «**xuddi ... -ganidek**», «**... -ganday**»: **as** I said (aytganimdek), **as** you know (bilganingizdek), **as** we expected (kutganimizdek), Do **as** I tell you (aytganimdek qil). Fe'lsiz turg'un iboralar: **as usual** (odatdagidek), **as always** (har doimgidek). Og'zaki nutqda ba'zan like ham shunday ishlatiladi (**like** I said), lekin yozma va rasmiy matnda **as** to'g'ri.

items.text: **As** I expected, the exam was much harder than last year's.
items.translation: **Kutganimdek**, imtihon o'tgan yilgisidan ancha qiyin bo'ldi.

items.text: Do **as** I say, not **as** I do.

blocks.text: **as** + ot odam yoki narsaning **haqiqiy vazifasi, roli** ni bildiradi: work **as** a nurse (hamshira bo'lib ishlamoq), **as** a parent (ota-ona sifatida), use the room **as** an office (xonani ofis sifatida ishlatmoq), **as** a present (sovg'a sifatida). **as a child** — «bolaligimda» (= when I was a child). Shuningdek: be known **as** (... nomi bilan tanilgan), regard / describe / treat ... **as** (... deb hisoblamoq / ta'riflamoq).

items.text: Kate works **as** a nurse at a children's hospital in Manchester.
items.translation: Keyt Manchesterdagi bolalar shifoxonasida hamshira **bo'lib** ishlaydi.

items.text: **As** a parent, I worry about how much time my kids spend online.
items.translation: Ota-ona **sifatida** bolalarimning internetda qancha vaqt o'tkazishidan xavotirdaman.

headers: as a ... — rostdan ham shu vazifada
rows: He talks **like a** doctor. (shifokor emas, lekin shunday gapiradi)
She treats me **like a** child. (men bola emasman)
**As a** child, I lived in Bukhara. (bolaligimda)
The palace is now used **as a** museum.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: 1) «He works **like** a teacher» (kasbi haqida) → He works **as** a teacher. «like» bu yerda «o'qituvchiga o'xshab ishlaydi» degan ma'no beradi. 2) «**As** my father, I love football» («otam kabi») → **Like** my father, I love football. 3) «You look **like** tired» → You look **tired** (sifat oldidan like yo'q). 4) «such like», «as for example» → **such as** / **like** (ikkalasi birga emas).

Tarjimadan tekshiring: «**sifatida**», «**bo'lib**» (ishlamoq), «**... paytida**» (bolaligida) — **as**; «**-dek**», «**... ga o'xshab**», «**... kabi**» — **like**. Savol bering: u rostdan ham shu narsami? Ha — as; yo'q, faqat o'xshaydi — like.
Bog'lanish: as ning vaqt va sabab ma'nolari — 116-dars; look / sound / feel **as if** — 118-dars; taqqoslash **as ... as** — 107-dars.

examples.title: **Like** = similar to: looks like, sounds like
examples.description: like — predlog: «... ga o'xshab», «-dek». Undan keyin ot, olmosh yoki -ing. look / sound / feel / smell / taste like.

sentences.text: Dilnoza sounds exactly **like** her mother, so people often confuse them on the phone.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning ovozi onasinikiga xuddi **o'xshaydi**, shuning uchun telefonda ularni ko'pincha adashtirishadi.

sentences.text: This new office building looks **like** a giant glass box.
sentences.translation: Bu yangi ofis binosi ulkan shisha qutiga **o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: What's your new boss **like**? — She's friendly but very demanding.
sentences.translation: Yangi boshlig'ing **qanaqa** odam? — Samimiy, lekin juda talabchan.

sentences.text: That noise outside sounds **like** a car alarm going off.
sentences.translation: Tashqaridagi bu shovqin mashina signalizatsiyasi chalinayotganiga **o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: After the storm, the beach looked **like** a battlefield.
sentences.translation: Bo'rondan keyin plyaj jang maydoniga **o'xshab qolgan edi**.

sentences.text: Walking around the new airport feels **like** being in a huge shopping centre.
sentences.translation: Yangi aeroportda yurish xuddi ulkan savdo markazida yurgan**dek** tuyuladi.

sentences.text: Nobody in our family cooks plov **like** my grandmother.
sentences.translation: Oilamizda hech kim buvim**dek** palov damlay olmaydi.

sentences.text: This herbal tea tastes **like** medicine — what's in it?
sentences.translation: Bu o'simlik choyining ta'mi doriga **o'xshaydi** — ichida nima bor?

sentences.text: Stop behaving **like** a child and say sorry to your sister.
sentences.translation: Bola**dek** o'zingni tutishni bas qil va singlingdan kechirim so'ra.

sentences.text: I'd love a garden **like** yours, but we live on the ninth floor.
sentences.translation: Sizniki**dek** bog'im bo'lishini juda istardim, lekin biz to'qqizinchi qavatda yashaymiz.

examples.title: **Like** and **such as** = for example
examples.description: like va such as — «masalan», «... kabi»: ro'yxatdan misol keltirish. such as biroz rasmiyroq.

sentences.text: Some messaging apps, **like** Telegram, are popular all over Central Asia.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi messenjerlar, **masalan**, Telegram, butun Markaziy Osiyoda mashhur.

sentences.text: Big cities **such as** London and Tashkent have serious traffic problems.
sentences.translation: London va Toshkent **kabi** yirik shaharlarda jiddiy tirbandlik muammolari bor.

sentences.text: I enjoy outdoor activities **like** hiking, cycling and fishing.
sentences.translation: Piyoda sayr, velosiped va baliq ovi **kabi** ochiq havodagi mashg'ulotlarni yoqtiraman.

sentences.text: You should eat more foods **such as** beans, nuts and green vegetables.
sentences.translation: Loviya, yong'oq va ko'katlar **kabi** oziq-ovqatlarni ko'proq iste'mol qilishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: Skills **such as** teamwork and communication matter as much as technical knowledge.
sentences.translation: Jamoada ishlash va muloqot **kabi** ko'nikmalar texnik bilimchalik muhim.

sentences.text: Jasur hates doing jobs around the house, **like** washing up or ironing.
sentences.translation: Jasur idish yuvish yoki dazmollash **kabi** uy ishlarini qilishni yomon ko'radi.

sentences.text: Countries **like** Japan and Korea invest heavily in robotics.
sentences.translation: Yaponiya va Koreya **kabi** davlatlar robototexnikaga katta sarmoya kiritadi.

sentences.text: Why don't you take up a sport, **such as** swimming or tennis?
sentences.translation: Nega biror sport bilan, **masalan**, suzish yoki tennis bilan shug'ullanmaysiz?

sentences.text: The museum displays objects **such as** ancient coins, pottery and manuscripts.
sentences.translation: Muzeyda qadimiy tangalar, sopol buyumlar va qo'lyozmalar **kabi** eksponatlar namoyish etiladi.

sentences.text: Doctors warn that sugary drinks, **like** cola and energy drinks, damage your teeth.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar kola va energetik ichimliklar **kabi** shirin ichimliklar tishga zarar berishini ogohlantiradi.

examples.title: **As** + clause: as I said, as you know, as usual
examples.description: as + ega + fe'l — «... -ganidek»: as I said, as you know, as we expected, do as I say. Fe'lsiz turg'un iboralar: as usual, as always.

sentences.text: **As** I said on the phone, the price includes breakfast and airport transfers.
sentences.translation: Telefonda **aytganimdek**, narxga nonushta va aeroport transferi kiradi.

sentences.text: **As** you know, the office will be closed for repairs next week.
sentences.translation: **Bilganingizdek**, kelasi hafta ofis ta'mir uchun yopiq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Please fill in the form exactly **as** the instructions say.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, anketani aynan yo'riqnomada **aytilganidek** to'ldiring.

sentences.text: Our flight was delayed because of the fog, **as** we had expected.
sentences.translation: **Kutganimizdek**, tuman tufayli reysimiz kechikdi.

sentences.text: Madina was late for the lesson **as usual**, but she had a good excuse this time.
sentences.translation: **Odatdagidek**, Madina darsga kechikdi, lekin bu safar uzrli sababi bor edi.

sentences.text: Do **as** the doctor tells you and stay in bed for a few days.
sentences.translation: Shifokor **aytganidek** qiling va bir necha kun yotib dam oling.

sentences.text: **As** always, the best seats were taken by people who arrived early.
sentences.translation: **Har doimgidek**, eng yaxshi o'rinlarni erta kelganlar egallab olishdi.

sentences.text: The old town of Khiva looks almost exactly **as** it did two centuries ago.
sentences.translation: Xivaning eski shahri deyarli ikki asr **avvalgidek** ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: Sales doubled in the second half of the year, **as** you can see from the chart.
sentences.translation: Diagrammadan **ko'rib turganingizdek**, yilning ikkinchi yarmida savdo ikki baravar oshdi.

sentences.text: Tom promised to fix the shelf, but **as usual** nothing happened.
sentences.translation: Tom javonni tuzatib qo'yishga va'da bergandi, lekin **odatdagidek** hech narsa bo'lmadi.

examples.title: **As** = in the role of: work as, as a teacher
examples.description: as + ot — «... sifatida», «... bo'lib»: kasb, vazifa, rol. Odam rostdan ham shu vazifada.

sentences.text: Nilufar works **as** a translator for an international company in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Nilufar Toshkentdagi xalqaro kompaniyada tarjimon **bo'lib** ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Before he became an actor, James worked **as** a waiter in a London café.
sentences.translation: Aktyor bo'lishidan oldin Jeyms Londondagi kafeda ofitsiant **bo'lib** ishlagan.

sentences.text: **As** a doctor, I can't recommend this diet to my patients.
sentences.translation: Shifokor **sifatida** bu parhezni bemorlarimga tavsiya qila olmayman.

sentences.text: My sister has been invited to the conference **as** a guest speaker.
sentences.translation: Opamni konferensiyaga mehmon ma'ruzachi **sifatida** taklif qilishdi.

sentences.text: **As** the team captain, Bekzod is responsible for talking to the referee.
sentences.translation: Jamoa sardori **sifatida** hakam bilan gaplashish Bekzodning zimmasida.

sentences.text: Emma spent a year in Samarkand **as** a volunteer English teacher.
sentences.translation: Emma ko'ngilli ingliz tili o'qituvchisi **sifatida** Samarqandda bir yil yashadi.

sentences.text: **As** your manager, I have to tell you that your reports are often late.
sentences.translation: Rahbaringiz **sifatida** aytishim kerak: hisobotlaringiz ko'pincha kechikadi.

sentences.text: Who will replace Oliver **as** head of marketing when he retires?
sentences.translation: Oliver nafaqaga chiqqach, uning o'rniga marketing bo'limi boshlig'i **bo'lib** kim keladi?

sentences.text: In the new series, the famous singer appears **as** a police officer.
sentences.translation: Yangi serialda mashhur xonanda politsiyachi **rolida** chiqadi.

sentences.text: Kate was chosen **as** the best young engineer of the year.
sentences.translation: Keyt yilning eng yaxshi yosh muhandisi **sifatida** tanlandi.

examples.title: **As** + noun: use as, as a present, as a child
examples.description: use something as (... sifatida ishlatmoq), as a present, as a child (bolaligida), be known as, regard / describe / treat ... as.

sentences.text: We use the spare room **as** an office when we work from home.
sentences.translation: Uydan ishlaganimizda bo'sh xonadan ofis **sifatida** foydalanamiz.

sentences.text: My colleagues gave me a smartwatch **as** a leaving present.
sentences.translation: Hamkasblarim menga xayrlashuv sovg'asi **sifatida** aqlli soat hadya qilishdi.

sentences.text: **As** a child, Aziz was terrified of dogs.
sentences.translation: **Bolaligida** Aziz itlardan juda qo'rqardi.

sentences.text: Samarkand is often described **as** the pearl of the East.
sentences.translation: Samarqand ko'pincha Sharq durdonasi **deb** ta'riflanadi.

sentences.text: The old factory is now used **as** a modern art gallery.
sentences.translation: Eski zavod hozir zamonaviy san'at galereyasi **sifatida** ishlatilmoqda.

sentences.text: Many people regard him **as** the best footballer of his generation.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik uni o'z avlodining eng yaxshi futbolchisi **deb** hisoblaydi.

sentences.text: Ibn Sina, known in Europe **as** Avicenna, was born near Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Yevropada Avitsenna **nomi bilan** tanilgan Ibn Sino Buxoro yaqinida tug'ilgan.

sentences.text: Please stop treating me **as** a beginner — I've been doing this job for ten years!
sentences.translation: Iltimos, meni yangi boshlovchi **deb** hisoblamang — bu ishni o'n yildan beri qilaman!

sentences.text: **As** a student, you can get cheaper tickets to most museums.
sentences.translation: Talaba **sifatida** ko'pchilik muzeylarga arzonroq chipta olishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: Sarah used her scarf **as** a bandage until the ambulance arrived.
sentences.translation: Tez yordam kelguncha Sara ro'molidan bint **sifatida** foydalandi.

examples.title: **Like a** ... or **as a** ...?
examples.description: like a teacher — o'qituvchiga o'xshab (aslida emas); as a teacher — o'qituvchi sifatida (rostdan ham). Juft gaplarda farqni his qiling.

sentences.text: My older brother sometimes talks to me **like** a teacher, which drives me mad.
sentences.translation: Akam ba'zan men bilan o'qituvchi**dek** gaplashadi, bu meni jinni qiladi.

sentences.text: **As** a teacher, Madina has to mark forty essays every weekend.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi **sifatida** Madina har dam olish kuni qirqta insho tekshirishi kerak.

sentences.text: Jasur isn't the boss, but he behaves **like** one.
sentences.translation: Jasur boshliq emas, lekin o'zini boshliq**dek** tutadi.

sentences.text: **As** the boss, Mrs Brown makes the final decision on hiring.
sentences.translation: Boshliq **sifatida** ishga olish bo'yicha yakuniy qarorni Braun xonim qabul qiladi.

sentences.text: The hotel room was so small that it felt **like** a prison cell.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona xonasi shunchalik kichkina ediki, qamoqxona kamerasi**dek** tuyuldi.

sentences.text: During the war, this building was used **as** a hospital.
sentences.translation: Urush yillarida bu bino kasalxona **sifatida** ishlatilgan.

sentences.text: Stop treating your little brother **like** a servant!
sentences.translation: Ukangga xizmatkor**ga qilgandek** muomala qilishni bas qil!

sentences.text: Oliver worked **as** a chef for years, so he cooks **like** a professional.
sentences.translation: Oliver yillar davomida oshpaz **bo'lib** ishlagan, shuning uchun professional**dek** ovqat pishiradi.

sentences.text: Kate's living room is so clean that it looks **like** a showroom.
sentences.translation: Keytning mehmonxonasi shunchalik toza ki, ko'rgazma zali**ga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: **As** your friend, I'm telling you not to sign that contract.
sentences.translation: Do'sting **sifatida** aytyapman: o'sha shartnomani imzolama.

examples.title: Dialogue: the new flatmate
examples.description: Ikki dugona yangi xonadosh haqida gaplashadi: like (o'xshatish, masalan), as (vazifa) va as + gap bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — So, what's your new flatmate **like**? Is he easy to live with?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, yangi xonadoshing **qanaqa** odam? U bilan birga yashash osonmi?

sentences.text: — He's great. He works **as** a nurse, so he's hardly ever at home.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r yigit. Hamshira **bo'lib** ishlaydi, shuning uchun uyda deyarli bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: — Lucky you! Does he cook, or does he live on takeaways **like** you?
sentences.translation: — Omading bor ekan! U ovqat pishiradimi yoki sen**ga o'xshab** tayyor ovqat bilan kun o'tkazadimi?

sentences.text: — Very funny. Actually, he cooks **like** a real chef.
sentences.translation: — Juda kulgili. Aslida, u haqiqiy oshpaz**dek** ovqat pishiradi.

sentences.text: — Did he bring lots of things with him, **like** furniture or plants?
sentences.translation: — O'zi bilan ko'p narsa olib keldimi, **masalan**, mebel yoki gullar?

sentences.text: — Only a huge sofa, which we now use **as** a guest bed.
sentences.translation: — Faqat ulkan divan, uni hozir mehmonlar uchun karavot **sifatida** ishlatamiz.

sentences.text: — **As usual**, you've found the perfect person. How do you do it?
sentences.translation: — **Odatdagidek**, eng zo'r odamni topibsan. Buni qanday uddalaysan?

sentences.text: — **As** I told you before, I always ask lots of questions first.
sentences.translation: — Senga avval **aytganimdek**, men doim oldin ko'p savol beraman.

sentences.text: — Well, my flatmate behaves **like** a teenager, although she's thirty.
sentences.translation: — Mening xonadoshim esa o'ttiz yoshda bo'lsa ham, o'zini o'smir**dek** tutadi.

sentences.text: — Then talk to her **as** a friend first, before you complain to the landlord.
sentences.translation: — Unda uy egasiga shikoyat qilishdan oldin u bilan do'st **sifatida** gaplash.

examples.title: Mixed: work, cities and modern life
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: like (o'xshatish, masalan), such as, as + gap va as + ot murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: **Like** many young people, Bekzod gets most of his news from social media.
sentences.translation: Ko'plab yoshlar **kabi**, Bekzod ham yangiliklarning ko'pini ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan oladi.

sentences.text: Tashkent is changing fast — some districts now look **like** parts of Dubai.
sentences.translation: Toshkent tez o'zgaryapti — ba'zi tumanlar endi Dubay**ga o'xshab** qolgan.

sentences.text: **As** the report clearly shows, unemployment fell for the third year in a row.
sentences.translation: Hisobotda aniq **ko'rsatilganidek**, ishsizlik ketma-ket uchinchi yil kamaydi.

sentences.text: Emma has worked **as** a journalist in three different countries.
sentences.translation: Emma uch xil mamlakatda jurnalist **bo'lib** ishlagan.

sentences.text: Some jobs, **such as** nursing and teaching, will always need real people.
sentences.translation: Hamshiralik va o'qituvchilik **kabi** ba'zi kasblarga doim tirik odamlar kerak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: My phone is so old that I only use it **as** an alarm clock.
sentences.translation: Telefonim shunchalik eskiki, undan faqat budilnik **sifatida** foydalanaman.

sentences.text: Don't just copy the answers — do the exercises **as** your teacher explained.
sentences.translation: Javoblarni ko'chirib qo'yaqolma — mashqlarni o'qituvching **tushuntirganidek** bajar.

sentences.text: The new manager speaks to everyone **like** an old friend, and the staff love her.
sentences.translation: Yangi rahbar hamma bilan eski do'st**dek** gaplashadi, xodimlar uni yaxshi ko'rishadi.

sentences.text: **As** a former athlete, Jasur knows exactly how to recover from injuries.
sentences.translation: Sobiq sportchi **sifatida** Jasur jarohatlardan qanday tiklanishni juda yaxshi biladi.

sentences.text: Nobody tells jokes **like** Kate — she should have her own TV show!
sentences.translation: Hech kim Keyt**dek** latifa ayta olmaydi — uning o'z teleko'rsatuvi bo'lishi kerak!
